title: A Survey on Bias and Fairness in Machine Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and summarizing various evaluation methods including word analogy tests for word embeddings, WEAT/SEAT metrics for sentence encoders, the WinoBias benchmark for coreference resolution, translation accuracy of gender-neutral pronouns in machine translation, and tracking error rates for male versus female name templates in Named Entity Recognition.

Surveying methods such as the comparison of false positive rates in risk assessment tools (e.g., COMPAS), and analyzing geographical and representational disparities in large-scale datasets (e.g., medical genomic databases and facial recognition benchmarks).
Reviewing evaluations of intersectional accuracy disparities across light-skinned and dark-skinned subjects in commercial facial recognition and gender classification systems.
Discussing the analysis of dataset representation and speaker demographic proportions across different age groups in training corpora (such as the Europarl dataset for machine translation).
